description.en: Sets an in-match event/cutscene parameter code, and optionally up to two ID pairs (each accepted as a string, hashed via CRC32, or a raw numeric ID) that the triggered match event can use.
Optional first ID (character/skill/etc.), only read when at least 3 arguments are given.
Optional second ID, only read when at least 3 arguments are given.
Optional third ID, only read when at least 5 arguments are given.
Optional fourth ID, only read when at least 5 arguments are given.
True once the event code (and any given ID pairs) has been stored; null if no eventCode argument was given.

example.code:
// Trigger a specific in-match cutscene event by its numeric code
CMND_BTL_SET_EVPARAM(44060010);
